text: Residents on Dingwall Avenue, between Pape Avenue and Carlaw Avenue, and Carlaw Avenue, between Dingwall Avenue and Riverdale Avenue, shared significant traffic safety concerns with my office as construction of the Ontario Line has proceeded. They have provided community feedback and completed a confidential ballot showing majority support for the installation of speed humps on Dingwall.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (four speed humps) on Dingwall Avenue, between Carlaw Avenue and Pape Avenue, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 8, 2026) from Councillor Paula Fletcher. 2. Requested staff maintain Watch Your Speed signs along Dingwall Avenue, between Pape Avenue and Carlaw Avenue, and Carlaw Avenue, between Dingwall Avenue and Riverdale Avenue, until the Ontario Line begins service. 3. Authorized Transportation Services to restore the previous permit parking regulations on the odd (south) and even (north) sides of Dingwall Avenue, from Carlaw Avenue to Pape Avenue. 4. Requested Transportation Services and Toronto Transit Commission to report back to the next Toronto and East York Community Council meeting regarding responsibility for the convex mirrors installed along Dingwall Avenue,…
